Reading it: about three of every four worker sprites are developers on medium or light, so the developer costume is the one you'll see most; designer comes next because so much of your work is UI and components (none of this session's titles used design words, so all its sprites drew as developers). Architect mostly appears on fable, which is rare, and planner only when a task title says plan or spec. In the crabs pack the chef (medium) and racer (light) dominate; the astronaut (fable) and detective (heavy) are rare.
